other.decision: Official current endpoint/model versions are deepseek-flash (V4.1 Flash 1017) and deepseek-v4-pro. V4 Flash legacy route and older weight families are outside current scope; old aliases are not reintroduced. The 260910 V4.1 snapshot is not the currently advertised 1017 version. Preserve the current 1017 and V4-Pro-0813 snapshot aliases.

Keep the active dynamic Qwen entry points plus mainstream 3.5–3.8 family and current coder/visual model. Keep snapshot aliases explicitly listed in the present official pricing tables, but remove older pre-current qwen-plus dates even where listed for legacy service. qwen3-coder-plus/its 2025-07-22 snapshot are absent from the current model and current pricing lists and models.dev marks it deprecated, despite older indexed docs mentioning it; omit conservatively. Omission is not evidence of shutdown for every third-party deployment.

Current global provider catalog lists the K2.6/K2.7/K3/K3.1 entries and official landing page promotes K3/K3.1; keep these core lines and priced highspeed variants. K2.5 remains deployed through Alibaba Model Studio, but is outside the newer mainstream scope; do not claim a universal retirement.

Official live text pricing lists GLM 5/5.1/5.2/5.3 and the 5.3 Flash and FlashX variants. Keep 4.7 and its free Flash as still prominent in current text/API plans; drop earlier GLM 4.5/4.6 families and lesser variants to honor requested scope, not because their API prices prove retirement.

Official pricing today advertises M3 and M3.1 Flash; models.dev MiniMax marks M2.5/M2.7 deprecated. M2.5 remains on Alibaba Model Studio, but third-party deployment alone does not warrant inclusion in the requested current core; do not claim global shutdown.

Official current text-API pricing explicitly lists 4.20 reasoning/non-reasoning/multi-agent, 4.3, 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7, including 0309 model IDs. Drop Grok Build 0.1 as non-core although the source still lists it.

Current official generalist/code catalog lists Large 4, Small 4, Ministral 3 3B/8B/14B and Codestral 25.08. Large 3 and Medium 3.5 are explicitly deprecated on official cards with a 2026-10-31 retirement date. Do not keep large-latest/medium-latest as standalone legacy entries without current owner routing evidence. Ministral official current names are ministral-{3b,8b,14b}-2512; remove aggregator-only -3-{size}-2512 aliases lacking official current ID confirmation. Do not conflate 4-0-8 with official 4 endpoint or assert it retired.
Meta currently distributes Llama 4 Scout and Maverick, including named deployment variants. Omit the older Llama 3.3 weights for scope rather than claiming Meta retired them.

Current means conservative mainstream core, not an assertion that every omitted model or alias is retired globally. Provider catalogs, official pricing and live-support evidence can differ across endpoints and region. No delivered file was changed.
